name: tiktok
tagline: Publish and Monitor TikTok from QuoxCORE
description: Governed TikTok video publishing and draft uploads on your own dedicated TikTok credential: direct video publish from the org media library, draft uploads to the account's TikTok inbox, profile and recent-video reads, per-video stats, and publish-status lookups. Two hard external truths shape this plugin honestly: an unaudited TikTok app is restricted to private (SELF_ONLY) viewing until TikTok approves the app audit, and access tokens live exactly 24 hours with no automatic refresh built yet.
shortDescription: TikTok video publishing and draft uploads on your own dedicated TikTok credential.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Publish a video from your org's media library with a governed, human-approved flow
Upload a video as a TikTok inbox draft, the recommended pre-audit workhorse
Read the connected profile, recent videos, and per-video stats
Honest 24-hour token countdown, amber under 12h and red under 4h
Every published post honestly stated as SELF_ONLY until your TikTok app audit clears
Your own dedicated TikTok credential, not shared with any other plugin

publishing.name: Video Publishing
publishing.description: Publish a video from a file already under the org's TikTok media root. Every publish files a human approval card first, then uploads and requests the chosen privacy level exactly as asked.

drafts.name: Draft Uploads
drafts.description: Upload a video to the connected account's TikTok inbox as a draft, finished and published manually inside the TikTok app. The recommended path before your app audit clears.

profile.name: Profile & Video Reads
profile.description: Read the connected profile (display name, avatar, follower/video counts) and recent videos with cover thumbnails and engagement counts.

stats.name: Video Stats & Publish Status
stats.description: Look up engagement stats for specific videos by id and check the status of a publish or draft upload by publish_id.

tokenHealth.name: 24h Token Health
tokenHealth.description: An honest hours-remaining countdown on the Health tab for the access token's 24-hour lifetime, since there is no automatic refresh built yet.

specialist.name: TIKTOK
specialist.description: TikTok video publishing and draft upload specialist on your own dedicated credential
capabilities: Publish a video from the org media library (human approval required)
Upload a video as a TikTok inbox draft (human approval required)
Read the connected profile and recent videos
Look up per-video stats and publish status

requirements.external: A TikTok developer app with the Content Posting and Display API products, and an access_token/refresh_token/client_key/client_secret quad stored in the vault

futureFeatures: Automatic token refresh (separate stream, YT-O-2 shared machinery)
Public (non-SELF_ONLY) publishing at scale once the app audit clears
Direct browser video upload (files must already sit in the org media root today)

changes: Governed video publishing from the org media library (human approval required)
Governed TikTok inbox draft uploads (human approval required)
Per-video stats and publish status lookups
